summary: Adds a /download endpoint that serves files from /srv/uploads by name. Also changes the dev server to bind to all interfaces with debug mode on.

findings.title: Path traversal in download endpoint
findings.problem: The download handler joins the name query parameter onto UPLOAD_DIR without any check. A name such as ../../etc/passwd or an absolute path like /etc/passwd escapes UPLOAD_DIR.
findings.consequence: Any client can read any file the server process can open. This includes secrets, config files and source code.
findings.fix: Use werkzeug safe_join or flask send_from_directory, which reject paths outside the base. Return 404 when the join fails.

findings.title: Debugger enabled on a server bound to all interfaces
findings.problem: The change turns on debug mode and switches the bind host from 127.0.0.1 to 0.0.0.0. This exposes the interactive Werkzeug debugger to the network.
findings.consequence: Anyone who can reach port 5000 can trigger the debugger console and run arbitrary code on the host.
findings.fix: Keep debug off by default and read it from an environment variable. Restore the 127.0.0.1 bind unless network exposure is required.

findings.title: New download endpoint has no covering test
findings.problem: The change adds a download endpoint with a 404 path and a file-serving path. No test file exists in the repository to exercise either path.
findings.consequence: Regressions in path handling, including traversal guards, would go unnoticed.
findings.fix: Add tests for a valid file, a missing file and a traversal attempt such as ../etc/passwd.

dropped.reason: The finding raised for c1 already covers the all-interfaces bind on this line. On its own, binding to 0.0.0.0 is a common deployment choice.
This duplicates c1, which is raised as a finding for the same debug flag on the same line.
